data.body:
File-by-file assessment of `~/rebar-membound` dirty WIP after landed memory work (2889 / commit b5509f548f4f7, plus 2866/2825 overlap): no salvageable change remains.

Verdicts:
- `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`: superseded by b5509. Main already has the same `mem_limit` values (gerrit 3072m, review-bot 2048m, opcert 256m, mcp 3712m) with current comments. WIP also removes `GERRIT_CANONICAL_WEB_URL`, which would regress the webhook-origin fix; discard.
- `infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh`: superseded/stale. Main already has `MCP_MEM_LIMIT=3712m` and `docker run --memory`; WIP is based on an older autodeploy shape and lacks later MCP self-heal/retire-cap/backoff fixes, so taking it would regress 2825-class behavior; discard.
- `rebar.toml`: superseded/stale commentary. Main already has `[snapshot].max_concurrent_gates = 2` with post-resize wording; WIP describes the old t4g basis; discard.
- `src/rebar/llm/errors.py`: functionally superseded. WIP only adds inline comments to fields already present on main; not worth a separate change under comment-hygiene policy; discard.
- `src/rebar/llm/gate_admission.py`: superseded and partially regressive. Main already has memory-aware admission, and WIP would remove later pytest xdist slot isolation/canonical scratch handling and uses less precise repo-root plumbing; discard.
- `tests/scripts/test_autodeploy_mcp_bluegreen.py`: superseded and regressive. Main already pins `--memory` parity; WIP deletes the landed dead-live-MCP self-heal tests/stub behavior, so discard.
- `tests/unit/test_alarm_window_tuning.py`: identical to main after 2889; no action.
- `infra/terraform/monitoring_membound.tf`: identical to main after 2889; no action.
- `tests/unit/test_compose_memory_limits.py`: superseded/stale. Main's version is post-r7g resize and asserts limits fit the resized 15678 MiB host with headroom; WIP still encodes the pre-resize 7813 MiB oversubscription model. Discard.
- `tests/unit/test_gate_admission_09da.py`: mostly comment/docstring expansions around tests that already exist on main, but WIP removes current isolation coverage (`test_xdist_worker_gate_slots_do_not_share_operator_slots`, sandbox default) and is therefore regressive; discard.

Conclusion: the dirty WIP is fully superseded by the landed ladybug/nene/scaup work, with several stale/regressive hunks. No new ticket or Gerrit change is warranted. I will reset/remove the worktree after recording this verdict.
